Zara Koh: hey all :wave: Zara here — just joined as infra SRE in SF. usually on west-coast evenings (6pm–2am PT) so hi to the night owls! cargo bike commuter 🚲, allergic to peanuts, collector of vintage calculators, and big into boardgames. happy to host a monthly in-office boardgame night — i can bring Catan + a weird indie RPG. also have a bearded dragon named Pixel :lizard: 
Jamie Patel: welcome aboard, Zara! :tada: night-shift overlap is actually super helpful — we run an evening on-call rotation. boardgame night sounds amazing.
Arjun Singh: yes please + Catan :d20: count me in.
Sam Price: cargo bike hype! we have an indoor bike rack — ping facilities to register it. also i’ll bring snacks for game night.
Priya Nair: bearded dragon??? need photos pls :eyes: :smile: 
Zara Koh: haha yes photos incoming. i'll also add a short peanut-allergy note to my desk profile and keep Pixel in a travel terrarium when he visits. don’t worry, no open peanut snacks from me.
facilities-bot: reminder — bike rack on B1 has spots available. email facilities@redwood.com to register your bike and get a sticker.
Arjun Singh: @Sam can you teach me Catan? first-timer here.
Sam Price: absolutely, i’ll show you the ropes — quick 20-min crash course before the first game night.
Jamie Patel: quick FYI — office pets guidance is in #help; reptiles are allowed if contained and you sign the short waiver. thanks for the heads-up about allergies.
Zara Koh: got it, will sign the waiver and drop Pixel’s pic in this thread later. excited to meet everyone in person — and down for lunch runs (i’m partial to bánh mì). :sandwich: 
Priya Nair: bánh mì friend! welcome again, Zara :wave: 
Sam Price: welcome!! :party_parrot:
